meta.title: Facade Texture Verification Map 3.0
meta.description: Four isolated 3x3 GU material towers plus a 1 GU thick concrete perimeter. Rebuilt 2026-07-11: the 2.0 nested-V layout stacked four equal-height (4 storey) walls 2 GU apart, so each nearer V's top sat lower on screen and exposed the one behind it, and the 2 GU thick perimeter rendered as two parallel walls at different heights. Both read as height bugs and were pure layout. The perimeter's 26 GU runs are deliberate: they are the only long runs in the project (column index up to 208) and are what exercise the junction out-of-plane case fixed in TOP-JUNCTION-06.
